description: Voice ID consent: grant and withdraw, with erasure on withdrawal.

cases.inputs: actorId: a user without consent; noticeVersion: "1.3".
cases.return: Success with the voice profile showing the new consent (MSG305 "Đã bật nhận diện giọng nói cho tài khoản của bạn.").
cases.log: Saved: consent row with notice 1.3 and its purpose; audit row records the grant.

preconditions: User consented to notice "1.2" and keeps voice samples.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user consented to "1.2"; noticeVersion: "1.3".
cases.return: Success (MSG305); the consent is renewed in place to 1.3 and the samples stay.
cases.log: Saved: consent notice renewed; audit row records the renewal with the old and new versions.

cases.inputs: actorId: a user consented to "1.3"; noticeVersion: "1.3".
cases.return: Success with the same profile (MSG305); agreeing again creates no new row.
Failure Invalid (MSG313); errors[noticeVersion] = ["Nội dung thông báo đã thay đổi. Hãy tải lại trang và đọc lại trước khi đồng ý."]; nothing is stored.
Failure Invalid (MSG313); consent is to the words the person actually read, so a missing version is refused.

preconditions: User has no active consent; the agree button is pressed twice at once.
cases.inputs: actorId: a user without consent; noticeVersion: "1.3" sent twice at the same time.
cases.return: Success (MSG305); one row wins and the other answer reads the same, so the person is agreed either way.
cases.log: Saved: one consent row; audit row records the grant.
